name: Remotion TSX Scene Core Standards
description: Строгие стандарты сборки React/Remotion компонентов: inline-layout, resolution-independent sizing, spring-физика, безопасные zone, шрифтовая иерархия
content:
RULES FOR REMOTION SCENE GENERATION:

1. Root Element: Absolute fullscreen container `<div style={{ position: 'absolute', inset: 0, overflow: 'hidden', display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', backgroundColor: montage.colors.background }}>` — НЕ через Tailwind.

2. Timing & Frame Rate: Never hardcode frames! Always calculate from `useCurrentFrame()` and `useVideoConfig()`. For 30fps, 1s = 30 frames.

3. Spring Physics: Use `spring({ fps, frame, config: { damping: 12, mass: 0.5, stiffness: 100 } })` for entering elements. Prefer `from: 0.92, to: 1` plus a separate opacity fade-in over `from: 0` (which causes a pop-in).

4. Clamping: When interpolating transforms, ALWAYS set `{ extrapolateLeft: 'clamp', extrapolateRight: 'clamp' }` to prevent element drift.

5. Shorts Safe Area: Keep crucial text inside vertical margins [top: 15%, bottom: 20%] to avoid overlap with TikTok/YouTube UI buttons. Compute from `unit = Math.min(width, height)`.

6. No External Fetch: Scenes must be strictly deterministic and renderable offline. All media must reference props or local IDs.

7. Deterministic Timing: Anchor every visual event to the fragment's `from`/`durationInFrames`. Never reuse stale frame offsets across fragments.

8. Type Safety: All component props must be typed. Use `React.FC<Props>` with explicit `Props` interface; no implicit `any`.

9. Motion Priority: When a fragment carries a verbal cue, emphasize the cue's key phrase with scale/color punch; secondary info stays visually static.

10. Unit Consistency: Keep coordinates and percentages relative to `useVideoConfig()` width/height; avoid magic pixel values.

11. LAYOUT VIA INLINE STYLES ONLY: Positioning, sizing, transforms, centering and gradients — ВСЕГДА через `style={{...}}`. Tailwind-классы для layout (absolute, relative, fixed, sticky, top-*, left-*, right-*, bottom-*, inset-*, w-*, h-*, min-w-*, max-w-*, p-*, m-*, gap-*, flex, grid, items-*, justify-*, content-*, translate-*, scale-*, rotate-*, skew-*, blur-*, bg-gradient-*, bg-linear-*, bg-clip-text, w-full, h-full, object-cover) ЗАПРЕЩЕНЫ. Причина: `TailwindPlugin` только инжектит переданный `customCss` и не генерирует утилиты в рантайме; Vidora вызывает `createDefaultRemotionSuite()` без CSS, поэтому layout-классы молча игнорируются и сцена рассыпается в document flow. Tailwind допустим ТОЛЬКО как косметика (шрифт, цвет текста, тень) — и всегда с inline-дублём.

12. RESOLUTION INDEPENDENCE: Все размеры вычисляй от `const { width, height } = useVideoConfig(); const unit = Math.min(width, height);`. Затем каждый размер — `unit * K`. Никаких `w-[600px]`, `h-40`, `bottom-24`. Иконки — `size={unit * 0.03}` через props, не через className.

13. NO FIXED PX IN LAYOUT: Значения вида `top: 100`, `width: 600`, `blur(120px)` в layout запрещены. Только `unit * K`.

14. WAVE/RIPPLE ANIMATIONS: Волна — отдельный компонент, живущий в окне `[startFrame, startFrame + life]`. Вне окна — `return null`. КАТЕГОРИЧЕСКИ запрещено `(frame + delay) % period`: `%` даёт скачок фазы и видимый pop на каждой перезагрузке периода. Несколько волн — параллельные инстансы с разными startFrame.

15. BEAT/PULSE ANIMATIONS: Двухфазный пульс через `interpolate(phase, [0, 0.12, 0.32, 1], [0, 1, 0.15, 0])`, где `period = Math.round(fps / 2)` (округляй, иначе дробный период даёт скачок фазы). НЕ используй `Math.max(0, Math.sin(...))` — это односторонний горб, читается как судорога.

16. SEQUENCE LAYOUT: Если дочерний компонент сам позиционируется абсолютно (`position: 'absolute'`), оборачивай его в `<Sequence layout="none">`. По умолчанию `Sequence` создаёт собственный `AbsoluteFill` и ломает `top`/`bottom`-раскладку ребёнка. ВНУТРИ `Sequence` помни: `useCurrentFrame()` отсчитывает от `from`, а `useVideoConfig().durationInFrames` — длина композиции. Их нельзя сравнивать напрямую, иначе `fadeOut` не сработает никогда: передавай длительность сцены пропом или вычитай `from`.

17. GRADIENT TEXT: `background: 'linear-gradient(...)'`, `WebkitBackgroundClip: 'text'`, `backgroundClip: 'text'`, `WebkitTextFillColor: 'transparent'`, `color: 'transparent'` — только inline через `style`. Tailwind `bg-clip-text text-transparent` в динамическом TSX не сработает.

18. LUCIDE ICONS: `size`, `color`, `fill` — через props и `style`, не через классы. `className="text-amber-300 fill-white"` может не примениться без TailwindPlugin. Центрирование иконки — inline-смещением (`top: 0, left: '50%', transform: 'translate(-50%, 0)'`).

Перед отдачей проверь по чек-листу docs/template_code/_SCENE_STANDARDS.md: в layout нет Tailwind, все размеры — unit * K, spring от 0.92, пульс двухфазный, волны через startFrame, Sequence с layout="none" для позиционированных детей. Референс-реализация: docs/template_code/Pulse.tsx.

name: Kinetic Typography & Text Staggering
description: Правила анимирования текстовых блоков и пословных субтитров
content:
KINETIC TYPOGRAPHY GUIDELINES:
1. Reveal Style: Animate words with a staggered entry (delay = index * 3 frames).
2. Contrast: Primary text must use `montage.colors.primary` or `#ffffff` with subtle dropshadow `drop-shadow-[0_4px_12px_rgba(0,0,0,0.8)]`.
3. Key Term Highlighting: Key punchy words must receive `montage.colors.accent`.
4. Scale Pop: Accompany text entry with a slight overshoot scale `interpolate(progress, [0, 0.7, 1], [0.8, 1.05, 1])`.
5. Readability Floor: Never animate text below 80% of its base size; keep minimum on-screen time of 24 frames for the most complex lockup.
6. Rhythm vs Voice: Break lines on clause boundaries, not mid-word; match line breaks to the fragment's sufler phrasing.

name: 5 Visual Archetypes Selection
description: Единая система из 5 визуальных архетипов для выбора ремарки каждого фрагмента
content:
VISUAL ARCHETYPE SELECTION RULES:
The visual treatment of every fragment must be chosen from exactly one of five archetypes:
1. PULL (Зум/Наезд): Camera or content zooms/pulls toward the subject. Best for emphasis, reveal, and dramatic weight. Use `scale` interpolation with `extrapolateRight: 'clamp'` and a slight ease-out.
2. EXPLODE (Взрыв/Разлёт): Elements burst outward, or a chart/object splits into particles or segments. Best for big-picture statistics, breakthroughs, or 'wow' moments.
3. CASCADE (Каскад/Поочерёдность): Staggered reveal of multiple items (lists, cards, comparison columns). Best for sequences, enumerations, and step-by-step logic.
4. FLOW (Течение/Движение по пути): A path, line, or element travels along a trajectory (arrows, timelines, 'from A to B'). Best for processes, journeys, and cause-effect.
5. PULSE (Пульс/Акцент-возврат): A beat-based emphasis, repeated accent, or heartbeat of a key metric. Best for reinforcement, rhythm, and countdown-like urgency.
CHOICE POLICY:
- Each fragment's `[VisualNote]` must name its archetype tag explicitly (e.g. `[VisualNote: PULL - лицо говорящего]`).
- Do not mix two archetypes in one fragment; keep a single dominant motion language.
- When in doubt, prefer CASCADE for enumeration and PULL for a single key idea.
- The archetype must map 1:1 to a concrete Remotion primitive (Sequence + spring for PULL, array-map with stagger for CASCADE/EXPLODE, interpolate on `x`/`y` for FLOW, modular pulse on `frame % beat` for PULSE).

name: Hook Analysis & 3-Second Retention
description: Психологические триггеры хука: разрыв шаблона, открытые петли и динамика кадра
content:
HOOK ANALYSIS EVALUATION CRITERIA:
1. Pattern Interrupt: Does the opening sentence challenge a common belief or highlight an anomaly within the first 1.5 seconds?
2. Curiosity Gap: Establish an unresolved question that can only be answered by watching until the end.
3. Visual Velocity: A new graphic element, punch-in zoom (1.15x), or b-roll cut must occur within frame 0 to frame 45.
4. Audio Clarity: Immediate vocal delivery with zero introductory silence.
5. Emotion Ladder: The hook should contain an explicit stake ('результат', 'цена', 'срок', 'секрет') that the viewer can map to their own outcome.
6. Brevity Ceiling: The hook must not exceed 2 sentences / ~14 words; anything longer risks a drop-off in the first 3 seconds.

name: Short-Form Viral Pacing & Scene Slicing
description: Разбиение сценария на микрофрагменты по 1.5-3 секунды
content:
SCRIPT PACING RULES:
1. Scene Duration: No visual scene should exceed 3.2 seconds without a visual transformation.
2. Fragment Density: Each scene fragment represents exactly one spoken thought (6-12 words).
3. Visual Notes: Each fragment must specify a concrete visual action (`[VisualNote: Chart plunges downward in neon red]`) plus an archetype tag.
4. Seamless Loop: The final sentence must syntactically or thematically lead directly into the opening hook sentence.
5. Pacing Ladder: Between hook and payoff, alternate fast (1.5-2.5s) and breathing (2.5-3.2s) fragments to avoid fatigue.
6. Cut Motivation: Every fragment boundary must be justified by EITHER a new spoken thought, a camera move, or a visual state change - never cut mid-idea by habit.

name: B-Roll Visual Integration & Overlay Rules
description: Правила рендера B-Roll интервалов: <OffthreadVideo>, затемнение, субтитры и стыковка с графикой
content:
B-ROLL VISUAL INTEGRATION RULES:
1. Import: Always `import { OffthreadVideo, staticFile } from 'remotion';` when a scene contains a b-roll fragment.
2. Layout: Render `<Sequence from={...} durationInFrames={...}>` containing `<OffthreadVideo src={...} className="w-full h-full object-cover" />`, a light darkening `<AbsoluteFill className="bg-black/30" />`, and a readable bottom-locked subtitle.
3. Overlay Discipline: Never place complex programmatic 2D graphics over a b-roll interval - only the darkening layer and a clean subtitle; let the footage breathe.
4. Timing Fidelity: Respect the fragment's exact `from`/`durationInFrames`; no overlap and no empty gaps between the video interval and neighbouring animation fragments.
5. Offthread Render: Always use `OffthreadVideo` (never `Video`) so renders are deterministic and frame-accurate.
6. Object Fit: Use `object-cover` and full-bleed; do not letterbox the footage.

name: B-Roll Matching Heuristics
description: Автоматическое сопоставление фрагментов с подходящими B-Roll файлами по семантике
content:
B-ROLL MATCHING HEURISTICS:
1. Semantic Anchor: Extract the dominant noun/keyword of the fragment text and match it against the normalized filename tokens (strip numbers, extension, split on '-' and '_').
2. Tag Priority: Prefer a video whose tags overlap with the fragment's archetype (PULL -> action/close-up footage; CASCADE -> array/process footage; FLOW -> paths/journeys).
3. Recall over Precision: If no confident match, fall back to the highest-scoring fuzzy token overlap; do NOT leave a fragment without a video when a b-roll pool is provided.
4. Dedup: Avoid reusing the same b-roll file for two consecutive fragments unless it is semantically required.
5. Aspect Consistency: Match portrait-ish fragments to vertical footage; refuse landscape footage for a vertical subject only if a better alternative exists.
6. Drift: When the selected footage's on-screen story contradicts the script, prefer the fragment's `[VisualNote]` intent over a literal filename match.

name: DeepTrend Blue Ocean Detection
description: Алгоритм обнаружения вирального потенциала темы с низким уровнем конкуренции
content:
BLUE OCEAN OPPORTUNITY CRITERIA:
1. Velocity Outlier: Channel videos with VPH (Views Per Hour) > 3x the channel median subscriber count.
2. Comment Gap: Identify recurring questions in top comments containing phrases like 'How did you...', 'What about...', 'Can you explain...'.
3. Competition Saturation: Discard topics where more than 5 channels with >1M subscribers posted videos in the past 14 days.
4. Search Momentum: A topic ranks higher when its search demand is recent (past 30 days) and growing, not flat from long ago.
5. Niche Arbitrage: Prefer topics where high-engagement content exists but production quality is uniformly low - the signal of an unattended lane.
